description: This file defines a class TextNormalization that implements text normalization for Markdown content, including slug normalization and configuration handling.

classes.name: TextNormalization
classes.description: A class responsible for normalizing text, particularly for slug generation, with configurable maximum length.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the configuration for the normalizer, updating the maximum length for slug truncation.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes the input text into a slug, applying prefix, slug transformation, and length restriction.
